notes.title: PATCH 03 - Open Test Server
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you're all having fun playing Aeon Wars Tactics on our Open Test Server! 
The team has been collecting your feedback from last month's playtest and working hard to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p]You may have seen it, but we pushed a patch yesterday. This patch fixes a couple of issues some of you have experienced and brings some new features:[/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]In-game tutorial system[/p][list][*][p]Certain tutorials will pop up contextually based on the first time the player interacts with something new.[/p][/*][*][p]Access all tutorials via the \[Escape] Settings menu. You can also turn off the automatic tutorials in this window.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mission Briefings[/p][list][*][p]Mission briefings will automatically pop up the first time the player enters an unplayed mission. Giving clear win conditions and a bit of flavour to the encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]Mission briefings are accessible at any time while in a match by clicking on the top left button named Objective.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the 3D space Unit Card on hover inside the Army Builder[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded the Unit Card tooltip inside the Army Builder and Play Area to pull more relevant stats about the unit[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Mechs equipped with AOEC primary weapons would target enemies outside of their Overwatch Cone[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed application of Skins and Chromas to specific Models - all models should now work with their available cosmetics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where throwing multiple stun grenades back to back would cause the subsequent grenades to have no effect/animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the above bug could also cause a crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where blending between specific animations while shooting with a grenade launcher would cause the model to scale up to the size of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blurriness in text inside the Collector Space[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Since we have made a lot of changes, this patch will delete all previously saved games. It's time to try new army rosters!

Also, we have a very rare and specific crash in the game at the moment. If you can find it and share with us your log or a video of it, you'll earn the [b]CRASH MASTER[/b] tag in our Discord! Hint to find it: "A Light Mekatron and three Demolishers walked into a bar..."  


Keep on playing and giving us feedback through our online form or our Discord server.[/p][p]We love to hear from you ❤️


[/p]

notes.title: New Playtest Build Available with Major Game Updates
notes.content:
[h3]Big Aeon Wars drop![/h3]

We know—it’s been nearly two years since the last update, it’s a long time. Despite the game industry's dark years of 2023-2024 and surviving a publisher going bankrupt, we managed to reboot Aeon Wars! 

We are back! Aeon Wars survived. Not only that, we’ve been using this time to polish, expand, and improve the game behind the scenes. 

Today, we’re incredibly proud (and excited!) to share a brand-new update packed with features, improvements, and content we can’t wait for you to explore. 

[b]It is live on Steam now! [/b]
If you haven't tried it yet, just head to our [u]Steam Page and try the Test Server[/u]. 

Thank you for sticking with us—or even just checking in again. We’re still here. The game is better than ever. And this is only the beginning of what’s next.

***

Now, onwards to the updated build! 

This version is in a pre-alpha state of development. This means it's in an incredibly early stage. Yet, we want to share our vision with you, the player. This playable is the core, the beating heart, of Aeon Wars' gameplay. Please help us shape its future. 

Nothing here is final. You are likely to find bugs. Your opinions and ideas are welcome, please send us a message through the ‘’Feedback’’ button in the quit game’s menu. We are also available on our Discord server. 

[h3]Currently implemented features[/h3]

+ Single PvE Skirmish mode against AI 
+ Hot Seat mode to play with a local friend or by yourself 
+ Two early playable maps and two scenarios (Capture Points and Deathmatch) 
+ First Strike Force from the Nesuv Faction, composed of nine unique infantry squads and two powerful 
   mechs 
+ Early stages Army Builder: Create your army and customise your loadout. Swap colours or apply skin 
   to your squads. 
+ Core combat mechanics: Deploy, Move, Shoot, use Gears and Special Abilities.
- We have unplugged the online multiplayer features for now.


Game mechanics may be missing or unclear. Audio is a placeholder, and visuals may appear inconsistent as we refine our style. Features such as progression, advanced unit customisation, model painting, collection display, and model posing are not included but mocked throughout this level to preview our intentions for this space.


We hope this early demo of our game allows you to taste its exciting potential and convinces you to embark with us on this journey. 


Together, let’s shape the future of wargaming! 


The entire team at Soliton Interactive wishes you a lot of fun!

notes.title: Opening of our Test Server: Playtest Aeon Wars Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re happy to announce that today, we are opening the new [b]Aeon Wars Test Server[/b] for all our community members! 

With this new playtest build, we want to give you access to the game while still in development. We are aiming to keep this playtest open for a long while. We’ll improve the game with small patches as often as we can and provide regular updates with new features for you to playtest and give feedback. Your input will greatly help us shape the best wargame out there!
 

[b]What has changed since the last playtest?[/b]
Here’s what you’ll find in this new and improved Pre-Alpha build:
[list]
[*] We're now on Unreal 5.1! (ok, it doesn’t change much right now, but it has opened a world of incredible possibilities for the future of the game and we can’t wait to share with you what we’re working on!)
[*] We implemented a Hotseat Mode (by hitting the “add a local player” button, you can now play against yourself to test units and tactics or do a 1v1 match with 2 local players swapping seats on the same device)
[*] We added a Hit Chance Popup while shooting at enemy models to give you the ability to min/max to your heart's content.
[*] You can now see your entire army at the bottom centre of the screen, and select your next unit from the UI rather than searching for an available unit on the battlefield (UI shows which units are Active/Available/Played/Dead)
[*] Additionally, we added an Active Unit UI at the bottom left of the screen - allowing you to preview the model's abilities and select who you want to shoot with next (while maintaining the option to swap active shooter with TAB)
[*] and many many bug fixes : )
[/list] Please note that for the time being, we have deactivated the matchmaker. You can either play by yourself or against a local friend on the same device using the “[i]Add a local Player[/i]” button for the Hotseat mode OR invite a Steam friend to play using the “[i]Invite Friend button[/i]”.

Looking for a friend to play but none of your Steam friends are available? Post in the :eyes: [b]looking-for-game[/b] channel of our Discord Server and see if someone in the awesome Aeon Wars community is ready to share a match!

 
[b]How do I join this new Test Server to play Aeon Wars?[/b]
If you downloaded the Aeon Wars Playtest build last February during our “P.R.E. Pre-Alpha Playtest”, you’re good to go! Just look for the game already in your Steam Library (the playtest is now called “Aeon Wars Test Server”), update it to get all the new patches, and have fun!

If you didn’t participate in the last playtest or can’t find the game in your Steam Library, you’ll need to claim your [b]Free Steam Key[/b] via our Discord server!
[olist]
[*] Join our Discord server here: [url=https://discord.gg/e8U9UCkP3Z]Join the Soliton Discord Server![/url]
[*] Jump into the :gift: |[b] test-server-keys channel[/b] and type the command [b]/claim[/b]. 
[*] In the pool space, type [b]test_server[/b]. Our generous Keybot will provide you with your unique Steam Key. 
[*] Claim your [b]Free Aeon Wars Key[/b] by clicking on the link provided in the Keybot message, download the Aeon Wars Test Server build in your Steam Library, and play!
[/olist]
 
[b]Can I stream content from the game? [/b]
YES! You can STREAM and make VIDEO content as much as you wish! Prepare your streaming overlays and let us know when you upload a video or go live so we can check it out and re-share your work with the Aeon Wars community.

[b]Where can I leave feedback? [/b]
Let us know what you think! Share your ideas or feedback with us via our Discord Server or by filling up the Google Form linked in the “[i]Quit Game Menu[/i]”! This will help us build the future of Aeon Wars : )

 [b]Where can I get support?[/b]
Problem while playing the game? You can find support via our Discord Server or alternatively, you can send us a message at support@solitoninteractive.com

notes.title: Our Pre-Alpha Playtest has ended!
notes.content:
Dear wargamers! 

Thank you for participating in our Pre-Alpha Playtest!

The last games have been played Monday just before 10pm (Est.time) which means the playtest has ended. Although only 5 days in time, this pre-alpha playtest made up for it's intensity as it was a blast! 
The enthusiasm was through the roof and we loved reading all your messages, ideas, suggestions and in-game war stories!

❤️ We want to thank everybody ❤️  for being on this journey with us and we can't wait to dive in and go through all the feedback we've received! 

If you still have any feedback, notes or messages for us, do let us know via our Discord Server (link below or on our store page). This is the best way to let us know your thoughts and helps us decide what to focus on next! 

What's Next? 
We will evaluate all your suggestions, feedback, and bug reports in order to make the game even better for everyone!
Stay tuned for announcements as Aeon Wars will be showcased in many upcoming events such as the Indie Cup Steam Event (February 14 to 21), the Ubisoft Indie Serie (finals on February 23) and more 👀 


You can follow Aeon Wars' development through our Discord Channel, our websites or our social medias 👇
